name: coping-classifier
limitations: All-shocks financial-expanded Stack A (logistic + histogram GB → logistic meta). Validated on the first 5-fold repeat only (macro F1 ≈ 0.502; formal F1 ≈ 0.315). Not compared against the prior 25-fold averages in the stacking decision. Stack B was stopped incomplete and is not a deployment candidate. Serving artefact is refit on the full modelling cohort (n=5,241). Not for operational targeting or eligibility decisions. SHAP LinearExplainer is not supported for this stacked model.

low_confidence_rule.description: Flag when score margin (max - second_max) < 0.10 OR predicted class is formal
